questions.question: Which of the following languages was added to the list of classical languages of India in 2024?
The Northern Regional Language Centre is located in which of the following cities?
In 2025, which eye disease was mentioned in the ‘Mann Ki Baat’ programme as having been eliminated from India?
What is the long period average (LPA) of seasonal rainfall over the entire country based on 1971-2020 data?
According to the World Bank, India ranks fourth globally in income equality with a Gini score of ________________.
As per Economic Survey 2024-25, the urban unemployment rate has dropped from 6.6% in Q2 FY 24 to _______________ in Q2 FY 25.
Who among the following was a general of the Mauryas, who set up the Shunga dynasty?
Who among the following established the Prarthana Samaj in Bombay (Mumbai) with the objective of rational worship and social reform?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Atma Ram Pandurang) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is a small bar magnet?
Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution states the provisions regarding 'Parliament to regulate the right of citizenship by law'?
Which organisation, along with The Natyanjali Trust, Chidambaram and others, organises the Natyanjali Dance Festival or Natyanjali Nritya Utsav?
options: The Ministry of Tourism, Government of India
The Department of Culture, Government of Tamil Nadu
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The Department of Culture, Government of Tamil Nadu) है।

questions.question: In August 2025, the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved an investment of ₹8,146.21 crore for the construction of which hydroelectric project in Arunachal Pradesh?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Tato-II Hydroelectric Project) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about entrepreneurship is/are INCORRECT?1. Entrepreneurship refers to the initiative taken by a person or a group of persons to start and organise a business.2. The one who takes the initiative of starting and organising a business is called an entrepreneur.3. The production accruing to an entrepreneur is termed as income.
Who among the following was nominated by Iltutmish as his successor?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (His daughter, Raziya) है।

questions.question: The first phase, called House Listing and Housing Census, was conducted across the country in 2010 between which two months?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (April and September) है।

questions.question: The northern plains being about ________ long and 240 to 320 km broad, is a densely populated physiographic division.
The fusion of two gametes that are dissimilar in size, is known as _____________.
What is the purpose of the 'Ideas4LiFE' initiative launched by Union Minister Bhupender Yadav in 2024?
options: To fund research in environmental science
To promote environment-friendly lifestyles and behaviours
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (To promote environment-friendly lifestyles and behaviours) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Articles states that Prime Minister shall be appointed by the President and other ministers shall be appointed by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister?
Who was the chairman of Union Public Service Commission in June 2024?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Dr Manoj Soni) है।
